marketing_description: The Milwaukee Brushless Precision Blower is a cordless tool featuring a brushless motor and a variable speed setting, delivering an air flow capacity of 39 CFM and a speed rating of 570 mph. This tool is part of the M18 Series and is powered by an M18 REDLITHIUM XC5.0 battery with a 5 Ah capacity, providing a run time of 30 min. With a comfort grip handle and a metal housing, this blower is designed for use with a range of applications.
